i.norm: Verifies that a Value built from an annotation with a null property list and all boolean flags set to false is equal to a copy produced by withIgnored() using the same (empty) ignored-for-serialization set, and that neither copy enables merging. Key behaviours exercised: - Value.from() treats a null value() array as an empty ignored-property set. - findIgnoredForSerialization() returns the ignored set when allowGetters is false. - withIgnored(Set) preserves all other flags, so the resulting Value is equal to the original. - The merge flag is false because Value.from() always sets merge=false.
Arrange: mock the annotation with all-false flags and a null property list.

Build a Value from the mocked annotation. Because value() returns null, the ignored-property set is empty. Because allowGetters() is false, findIgnoredForSerialization() returns that empty set. Value.from() always uses merge=false, so getMerge() will be false on the result.
Act: obtain the ignored-for-serialization set and create a copy with the same set.
Assert: the copy is equal to the original (same ignored set and same flags), and neither Value has merge enabled.
